short_description: Show the age of the latest completed Mac backup and the time left before it becomes overdue.
description: Show the age of the latest completed Mac backup and the time left before it becomes overdue. Set max_hours to your preferred freshness limit. The host reads tmutil latestbackup -t. Connect or mount the Time Machine destination so macOS can find its latest completed copy. A missing or inaccessible destination is reported as unavailable. The app does not start a backup.
